headline: Powell outlines the *economic pain* of fighting inflation
quote: higher interest rates, slower growth, and a softening labor market
title: Powell, Sep 2022: Higher rates and slower growth cause economic pain
caption: Fed Chair Jerome Powell explained the trade-offs of raising interest rates to curb high inflation. He noted that while policy tightening causes short-term hardship, failing to restore price stability would be far worse.
comment: How have higher interest rates affected your financial decisions?
